findings.title: Redis OSS 7.1 cache is supported; optional move to Valkey
findings.description:
aws_elasticache_cluster.redis_cluster (aws/redis/main.tf:14) sets engine = "redis" (main.tf:16) and engine_version = var.redis_version (main.tf:17), which defaults to "7.1" (variables.tf:14). Redis OSS 7.1 is not in the Extended Support schedule (source: AWS docs, extended-support-versions.html), so status is SUPPORTED and no Extended Support charge applies. The version was resolved from the module default only: no caller, tfvars or root module in this repository sets redis_version, and live data was not read (live_access=off). If a consumer of this module passes 4.x, 5.x or 6.x, rerun the analysis against that configuration. Recommended optional target: Valkey 9 (9.1, confirm with DescribeCacheEngineVersions) for about 20% lower node-based price; no application code in the repository blocks it. Two blockers (single-node aws_elasticache_cluster, in-transit encryption unset) must be resolved before any Valkey move. Risk Medium (score 3): single-node cluster +2, no test/staging environment found +1.

findings.title: Single-node aws_elasticache_cluster cannot cross-engine upgrade to Valkey
findings.description: aws_elasticache_cluster.redis_cluster uses engine redis with no replication_group_id (num_cache_nodes default 1, variables.tf:36). A single-node cluster can't cross-engine upgrade to Valkey. Proposed manual change: refactor into an aws_elasticache_replication_group (separate change, ideally with a replica and automatic failover), then rerun the analysis. Not auto-fixed. Staying on Redis OSS 7.1 (target C) needs no change.

findings.title: In-transit encryption not set (needed for a Valkey replication group)
findings.description: transit_encryption_enabled is not set on aws_elasticache_cluster.redis_cluster. CloudFormation docs and cfn-lint require TransitEncryptionEnabled when creating a Valkey replication group; whether an in-place engine change also requires it is not confirmed. Turning on TLS changes how every client connects. Proposed manual change: when refactoring into a replication group, decide whether to enable TLS (transit_encryption_mode = preferred first, then required) or to stay on Redis OSS 7.1 (target C). Not set automatically.

findings.title: Effective engine version resolved from module default only
findings.description: aws/redis is a reusable module with no caller in this repository (no module block, tfvars or root configuration sets redis_version, region, instance_type or num_cache_nodes). The analysis uses the defaults (redis_version 7.1, cache.t2.micro, 1 node) and region is unresolved (var.region has no default). Consumers in other repositories may override these values; run the analysis there too. Also confirm the node type is offered for the chosen target engine in the Region before upgrading.
